The '''Republic Recon Post''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Western Ice Shelf]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
The base was used by the Republic during the fightings against [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces that followed the return of the ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' on Ilum. Gree vendors [[Birak'k]] and [[Rodok'k]] operated in this base.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
